title: SEC4: Rename sanitize_display to strip_ansi_escape_sequences for clarity
description: app.rs lines 109-132. Function name 'sanitize_display' is vague about intent. Better name: 'strip_ansi_escape_sequences' or 'strip_ansi_sgr' matches the behavior (removing ANSI SGR color/style codes). Doc comment is excellent; just the name is unclear.
